title: Help & Support
subtitle: Product help, usage guidance and support contact.

gettingStarted.title: Getting Started
gettingStarted.body: Sign in with the email and password your administrator set up for you. On the Dashboard, use Clock In to start your shift and Clock Out to end it. Your organization's site(s) and any camera/GPS requirements are configured by your administrator.

attendance.title: Clocking In & Out
attendance.body: Choose your site (and project, if applicable) before clocking in. Some sites require a photo before you can clock in or out. If you clock in or out outside your assigned work area, you will be asked to explain why - your explanation is reviewed by a manager.

timesheets.title: Timesheets
timesheets.body: Once your manager generates a timesheet for a period, it appears under Timesheets for you to review and submit for approval. Worked time, breaks and overtime are shown as separate totals. Once approved, a timesheet is locked - if you believe it needs a correction, you can request one from the timesheet's own page.

kiosk.title: Kiosk Mode
kiosk.body: At sites with a shared kiosk device, select your name from the list, enter your personal kiosk PIN, then Clock In or Clock Out. Your kiosk PIN is separate from your login password - set or change it from the Dashboard.

exceptions.title: Exceptions
exceptions.body: If you clock in or out outside your assigned work area, this is recorded as an exception. Provide a short reason from the Dashboard so a manager can review it.

allowances.title: Allowances
allowances.body: Open Allowances from the sidebar and pick a date to add an entry - the date, site and clock-in/out are filled in automatically. Fill in meal, transportation, housing and other amounts yourself, then Submit. A manager or the Owner approves or rejects it; while it's a draft you can still edit and re-save it. Overtime hours/days are computed automatically from your site's shift policy, if one is configured.

sites.title: Sites & Shift Policy (Administrators)
sites.body: Sites (Owner/Manager only) is where worksites, their GPS geofence, kiosk mode and camera/attendance policy are configured, and where employees/managers are assigned to a site. Each site can also have its own optional shift policy - work hours, when overtime and lateness deductions start counting, a grace period, and whether an employee is blocked from self clock-in past that grace period (in which case a manager clocks them in instead, with a reason).

permissions.title: Permissions (Administrators)
permissions.body: Each person's page under People shows their real granted permissions and lets an authorized administrator grant, revoke, or reset an individual permission with a reason - visible only to those who already hold that authority. The Owner always has every permission; other roles start from a default bundle that can be adjusted per person.

q1.question: I forgot to clock out - what do I do?
q1.answer: Contact an administrator or manager - they can record the correct Clock Out on your behalf, and the action is recorded as theirs, not yours.

q2.question: Why was my Clock In flagged as outside my work area?
q2.answer: Your site has a configured geofence and GPS accuracy tolerance. If your reported location fell outside that area, you're asked to explain why so a manager can review it.

q3.question: Can I use the app while offline?
q3.answer: Clock In and Clock Out are queued locally if you lose connectivity and sync automatically once you're back online - you'll see a pending-sync notice until it's confirmed.

q4.question: How do I change the language or theme?
q4.answer: Open the user menu (bottom of the sidebar) - Language and Appearance (Dark/Light/System) can be changed there at any time.

q5.question: I clocked in without choosing a site - why did it ask for a "workplace"?
q5.answer: Site is optional so you can register attendance from your real current location even when it isn't a registered site - but a short description of where you actually are is required in that case, so reports never show a blank site.

q6.question: What's the difference between Attendance Record and Timesheets?
q6.answer: Attendance Record is a live, date-ranged log of clock-in/out events - nothing to approve. Timesheets are a generated, period-based object (worked/break/overtime totals) that goes through a real submit -> approve workflow and gets locked once approved.

q7.question: Can I export my attendance or timesheet as a PDF?
q7.answer: Yes - Attendance Record, Timesheets and Allowances each have their own Export PDF action, scoped to whatever you're currently viewing.

q8.question: Why can't I see some employees in People or Attendance Record?
q8.answer: You only ever see yourself, plus - if you manage a site - the people assigned to that site. The Owner sees everyone. This is enforced by the server, not just hidden in the interface.
